metadata.scientific_source: ICAR-SBI Coimbatore, ICAR-IISR Lucknow, WTC Rahuri

rules.response_en:
💧 SUGARCANE WATER REQUIREMENT:

📊 Total: 1500-2000 mm (12 month crop)
📊 Daily: 5-8 mm/day (peak demand)

🌱 Germination: Light, frequent (7-10 days)
🌿 Tillering: Moderate (10-12 days)
🌾 Grand Growth: CRITICAL - heavy (7-10 days)
🍯 Maturity: Reduced (15-20 days)

⚠️ Stop irrigation 15-20 days before harvest for sugar accumulation
rules.response_hi:
💧 गन्ना जल आवश्यकता:

📊 कुल: 1500-2000 mm
📊 दैनिक: 5-8 mm/day (अधिकतम मांग)

⚠️ कटाई से 15-20 दिन पहले सिंचाई बंद करें
rules.response_mr:
💧 ऊस पाणी गरज:

📊 एकूण: 1500-2000 mm
📊 दैनिक: 5-8 mm/day (कमाल मागणी)

⚠️ कापणीपूर्वी 15-20 दिवस पाणी बंद करा

rules.response_en:
🌱 GERMINATION IRRIGATION (0-35 DAP):

✅ First irrigation: Immediately after planting (light)
✅ Frequency: Every 7-10 days
✅ Method: Furrow irrigation, avoid flooding
✅ Depth: Light irrigation only

⚠️ CRITICAL: Maintain moisture but avoid waterlogging - causes sett rot!
⚠️ Reduce interval to 5 days in hot/dry weather
rules.response_hi:
🌱 अंकुरण सिंचाई (0-35 DAP):

✅ पहली सिंचाई: रोपण के तुरंत बाद
✅ आवृत्ति: हर 7-10 दिन

⚠️ नमी बनाए रखें लेकिन जलभराव से बचें!
rules.response_mr:
🌱 उगवण सिंचन (0-35 DAP):

✅ पहिले पाणी: लागवडीनंतर लगेच
✅ वारंवारता: दर 7-10 दिवसांनी

⚠️ ओलावा ठेवा पण पाणी साचू देऊ नका!

rules.response_en:
🌿 TILLERING IRRIGATION (35-120 DAP):

✅ Frequency: Every 10-12 days (winter), 7-10 days (summer)
✅ Method: Full furrow irrigation
✅ Critical: Maximum tillering at 60-90 DAP needs adequate water

⚠️ Water stress reduces tillers by 20-30%
⚠️ Earthing up after each irrigation improves tiller survival
rules.response_hi:
🌿 कल्ला निकलने पर सिंचाई (35-120 DAP):

✅ आवृत्ति: हर 10-12 दिन
✅ महत्वपूर्ण: 60-90 DAP पर अधिकतम कल्ले

⚠️ पानी की कमी से 20-30% कम कल्ले
rules.response_mr:
🌿 फुटवा अवस्था सिंचन (35-120 DAP):

✅ वारंवारता: दर 10-12 दिवसांनी
✅ महत्त्वाचे: 60-90 DAP ला कमाल फुटवे

⚠️ पाण्याचा ताण असल्यास 20-30% कमी फुटवे

rules.response_en:
🌾 GRAND GROWTH IRRIGATION (120-270 DAP) - MOST CRITICAL:

✅ Frequency: Every 7-10 days (MANDATORY)
✅ Water demand: Maximum (6-8 mm/day)
✅ This stage determines YIELD - stress causes 40-50% yield loss!

⚠️ NEVER skip irrigation during monsoon break
⚠️ Heavy irrigation for internode elongation
⚠️ 70% of total water consumed in this phase
rules.response_hi:
🌾 भव्य वृद्धि सिंचाई (120-270 DAP) - सबसे महत्वपूर्ण:

✅ आवृत्ति: हर 7-10 दिन (अनिवार्य)
✅ पानी की मांग: अधिकतम

⚠️ तनाव से 40-50% उपज हानि!
rules.response_mr:
🌾 ग्रँड ग्रोथ सिंचन (120-270 DAP) - सर्वात महत्त्वाचे:

✅ वारंवारता: दर 7-10 दिवसांनी (अनिवार्य)
✅ पाण्याची मागणी: कमाल

⚠️ ताणामुळे 40-50% उत्पादन घट!

rules.cause: Maturity stage irrigation - reduce for sugar
rules.response_en:
🍯 MATURITY IRRIGATION (270-360 DAP):

✅ Frequency: Every 15-20 days (reduced)
✅ Gradually reduce irrigation for sugar accumulation
✅ STOP irrigation 15-20 days before harvest

⚠️ Excess water reduces sucrose by 1-2%
⚠️ Mild stress increases sugar concentration
⚠️ Monitor for lodging if over-watered
rules.response_hi:
🍯 परिपक्वता सिंचाई (270-360 DAP):

✅ आवृत्ति: हर 15-20 दिन (कम करें)
✅ कटाई से 15-20 दिन पहले सिंचाई बंद

⚠️ अधिक पानी से चीनी 1-2% कम
rules.response_mr:
🍯 परिपक्वता सिंचन (270-360 DAP):

✅ वारंवारता: दर 15-20 दिवसांनी (कमी)
✅ कापणीपूर्वी 15-20 दिवस पाणी बंद

⚠️ जास्त पाण्याने साखर 1-2% कमी

rules.response_en:
💧 DRIP IRRIGATION FOR SUGARCANE:

✅ Water saving: 40-50%
✅ Yield increase: 20-30%
✅ Layout: Surface drip, 16mm lateral, 60cm spacing
✅ Daily run: 45-60 min (summer), 30-45 min (winter)
✅ Subsidy: 55-90% under PMKSY

📊 Economics: Payback in 2-3 years

⚠️ Install sand filter + screen filter for clean water
rules.response_mr:
💧 उसासाठी ठिबक सिंचन:

✅ पाणी बचत: 40-50%
✅ उत्पादन वाढ: 20-30%
✅ अनुदान: 55-90%

rules.response_en:
⚠️ WATER STRESS DETECTED:

Symptoms: Leaf rolling, wilting in afternoon, yellowing lower leaves

✅ IMMEDIATE: Irrigate within 24 hours
✅ Recovery spray: 2% Urea + 1% KCl after irrigation
✅ If severe: Reduce N-fertilizer by 25% (plant can't utilize)

📊 Yield loss: 5-7% per day of stress during grand growth

⚠️ Don't apply fertilizer during stress - causes burn
rules.response_hi:
⚠️ पानी तनाव का पता चला:

लक्षण: पत्ती मुड़ना, दोपहर में मुरझाना

✅ तुरंत: 24 घंटे में सिंचाई करें
✅ सिंचाई के बाद 2% यूरिया छिड़कें
rules.response_mr:
⚠️ पाण्याचा ताण आढळला:

लक्षणे: पान गुंडाळणे, दुपारी कोमेजणे

✅ तात्काळ: 24 तासांत पाणी द्या
✅ पाण्यानंतर 2% युरिया फवारा

rules.response_en:
🌊 WATERLOGGING DETECTED:

Symptoms: Yellowing, root rot, fungal diseases increase

✅ IMMEDIATE: Drain water using furrow outlet/pump
✅ After drainage: Spray Carbendazim 1g/L (fungal prevention)
✅ Apply Potash 20 kg/ha to strengthen plants
✅ Earthing up to improve aeration

⚠️ Sugarcane tolerates 48-72 hours waterlogging
⚠️ Beyond 5 days: 30-40% yield loss
rules.response_hi:
🌊 जलभराव का पता चला:

✅ तुरंत: पानी निकालें
✅ निकासी के बाद: कार्बेन्डाजिम 1g/L छिड़कें

⚠️ 5 दिनों से अधिक: 30-40% उपज हानि
rules.response_mr:
🌊 पाणी साचणे आढळले:

✅ तात्काळ: पाणी काढून टाका
✅ निचऱ्यानंतर: कार्बेन्डाझिम 1g/L फवारा

⚠️ 5 दिवसांपेक्षा जास्त: 30-40% उत्पादन घट

rules.response_en:
💧 FLOOD IRRIGATION BEST PRACTICES:

✅ Furrow length: 30-50 m maximum
✅ Land leveling: Essential for uniform distribution
✅ Inflow rate: 2-3 LPS per furrow
✅ Cut-off time: When water reaches 75% of furrow

📊 Water use efficiency: Only 40-50%
📊 Consider: Alternate furrow irrigation saves 25% water

⚠️ Night irrigation reduces evaporation loss by 20%
rules.response_hi:
💧 बाढ़ सिंचाई सर्वोत्तम प्रथाएं:

✅ नाली लंबाई: 30-50 m अधिकतम
✅ भूमि समतलीकरण: आवश्यक

📊 रात्रि सिंचाई से 20% कम वाष्पीकरण
rules.response_mr:
💧 पूर सिंचन सर्वोत्तम पद्धती:

✅ सरी लांबी: 30-50 m कमाल
✅ जमीन सपाटीकरण: आवश्यक

📊 रात्री सिंचनाने 20% कमी बाष्पीभवन

rules.response_en:
💧 ALTERNATE FURROW IRRIGATION:

✅ Irrigate alternate furrows only
✅ Water saving: 25-35%
✅ Yield reduction: Only 5-10% (acceptable trade-off)
✅ Best for: Water-scarce areas, grand growth stage

📋 Method: Irrigate furrow 1,3,5 in first irrigation; 2,4,6 in next

⚠️ Not recommended for: Germination, extreme drought
rules.response_hi:
💧 वैकल्पिक नाली सिंचाई:

✅ केवल वैकल्पिक नालियों में सिंचाई
✅ पानी बचत: 25-35%
✅ उपज कमी: केवल 5-10%
rules.response_mr:
💧 पर्यायी सरी सिंचन:

✅ फक्त पर्यायी सऱ्यांत पाणी
✅ पाणी बचत: 25-35%
✅ उत्पादन घट: फक्त 5-10%

rules.response_en:
🍂 MULCHING FOR WATER CONSERVATION:

✅ Use: Sugarcane trash 10-12 t/ha
✅ Water saving: 2-3 irrigations (20-25%)
✅ Additional benefits: Weed control, cool soil, adds nutrients

📋 Apply: After first/second irrigation in inter-row spaces

⚠️ Avoid fresh trash near plant base (attracts termites)
⚠️ Spray Trichoderma to speed decomposition
rules.response_hi:
🍂 पानी बचत के लिए मल्चिंग:

✅ उपयोग: गन्ना पराली 10-12 t/ha
✅ पानी बचत: 2-3 सिंचाई (20-25%)
rules.response_mr:
🍂 पाणी बचतीसाठी आच्छादन:

✅ वापर: ऊस पाचट 10-12 t/ha
✅ पाणी बचत: 2-3 पाणी (20-25%)

rules.response_en:
🌧️ MONSOON BREAK IRRIGATION:

✅ If no rain for 10-15 days during monsoon: IRRIGATE!
✅ Grand growth stage: Most vulnerable to dry spells
✅ One life-saving irrigation can prevent 30% yield loss

📊 Monitor: Soil moisture, leaf rolling, weather forecast

⚠️ Don't assume monsoon means no irrigation needed
⚠️ July-August dry spells are common and critical
rules.response_hi:
🌧️ मानसून ब्रेक सिंचाई:

✅ मानसून में 10-15 दिन बारिश नहीं: सिंचाई करें!
✅ एक सिंचाई 30% उपज हानि रोक सकती है
rules.response_mr:
🌧️ मान्सून खंडात सिंचन:

✅ मान्सूनमध्ये 10-15 दिवस पाऊस नाही: पाणी द्या!
✅ एक पाणी 30% उत्पादन घट टाळू शकते

rules.response_en:
☀️ SOLAR PUMP FOR SUGARCANE:

✅ Recommended: 5-7.5 HP for drip, 10 HP for flood irrigation
✅ Subsidy: 60-90% under PM-KUSUM
✅ Savings: ₹30,000-50,000/year on electricity
✅ Lifespan: 25 years (panels), 15 years (pump)

📋 Apply through: Agriculture Department or DISCOM

⚠️ Best combined with drip for maximum efficiency

🌱 RATOON IRRIGATION:

✅ First irrigation: Within 7 days of harvest (CRITICAL)
✅ Second: After stubble shaving + fertilizer (10-15 days)
✅ Frequency: Same as plant crop but start earlier

📋 Key: Ratoon root system is shallower - needs MORE frequent, LIGHTER irrigation

⚠️ Water stress in first 45 days kills ratoon sprouts
⚠️ Ratoon needs 10-15% more water than plant crop
rules.response_hi:
🌱 रैटून सिंचाई:

✅ पहली सिंचाई: कटाई के 7 दिनों के भीतर
✅ रैटून को पौध फसल से 10-15% अधिक पानी चाहिए
rules.response_mr:
🌱 खोडवा सिंचन:

✅ पहिले पाणी: कापणीनंतर 7 दिवसांत
✅ खोडव्याला रोप पिकापेक्षा 10-15% जास्त पाणी लागते

rules.response_en:
⚠️ SALINE WATER IRRIGATION:

✅ Sugarcane tolerance: EC up to 4 dS/m (moderately tolerant)
✅ Pre-sowing irrigation: Use good quality water if available
✅ Leaching: 20-25% extra water to wash salts below root zone
✅ Frequency: More frequent, lighter irrigation

📋 Apply Gypsum @5 t/ha annually
📋 Use FYM/organic matter to improve soil structure

⚠️ Avoid saline water during germination (sensitive stage)
rules.response_hi:
⚠️ खारे पानी से सिंचाई:

✅ गन्ना सहनशीलता: EC 4 dS/m तक
✅ लीचिंग: 20-25% अतिरिक्त पानी
rules.response_mr:
⚠️ खारट पाण्याने सिंचन:

✅ ऊस सहनशीलता: EC 4 dS/m पर्यंत
✅ लीचिंग: 20-25% अधिक पाणी

rules.response_en:
🌧️ SPRINKLER IRRIGATION FOR SUGARCANE:

✅ Useful for: Germination stage, pre-planting irrigation
✅ Not recommended: After 90 DAP (tall crop, wind drift)
✅ Water saving: 20-30% vs flood

⚠️ LIMITATION: Disease spread in wet canopy
⚠️ Wind >15 km/hr reduces efficiency
⚠️ Drip is better choice for sugarcane
rules.response_hi:
🌧️ गन्ने के लिए स्प्रिंकलर:

✅ उपयोगी: अंकुरण चरण
✅ अनुशंसित नहीं: 90 DAP के बाद
rules.response_mr:
🌧️ उसासाठी स्प्रिंकलर:

✅ उपयुक्त: उगवण अवस्था
✅ शिफारस नाही: 90 DAP नंतर

rules.response_en:
💧 SUBSURFACE DRIP IRRIGATION (SDI):

✅ Installation: Laterals at 15-20 cm depth
✅ Water saving: 50-60% vs flood
✅ Yield increase: 25-35%
✅ Weed reduction: Surface stays dry

📊 Higher initial cost but lower maintenance
📊 Lifespan: 8-10 years

⚠️ Requires: Good filtration, experienced installation
⚠️ Rodent damage possible - use thick-walled laterals
rules.response_hi:
💧 भूमिगत ड्रिप सिंचाई (SDI):

✅ पानी बचत: 50-60%
✅ उपज वृद्धि: 25-35%
rules.response_mr:
💧 भूमिगत ठिबक सिंचन (SDI):

✅ पाणी बचत: 50-60%
✅ उत्पादन वाढ: 25-35%

rules.response_en:
📊 SUGARCANE WATER BUDGET (per hectare):

💧 Total requirement: 15,000-20,000 m³/ha/year
💧 Monsoon contribution: 800-1200 mm (varies by region)
💧 Irrigation need: 600-1000 mm (6,000-10,000 m³)

📋 Well capacity needed: 2-3 inch for 1 ha (with flood)
📋 With drip: 1-1.5 inch well sufficient

⚠️ Plan water source before planting sugarcane!
rules.response_hi:
📊 गन्ना पानी बजट (प्रति हेक्टेयर):

💧 कुल आवश्यकता: 15,000-20,000 m³/वर्ष
💧 सिंचाई आवश्यकता: 6,000-10,000 m³
rules.response_mr:
📊 ऊस पाणी बजेट (प्रति हेक्टर):

💧 एकूण गरज: 15,000-20,000 m³/वर्ष
💧 सिंचन गरज: 6,000-10,000 m³
